about_the_game:
Go deeper than ever before in Clank! Sunken Treasures!

  • The dungeons have flooded, offering daring thieves two new underwater maps to explore – enter The Pirate Ship and Seaside Castle!

  • 35 new Dungeon Deck cards bring new threats…and new tools to overcome them!

  • Nine new Challenges and 11 new Achievements provide new ways to test your skills!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600M GT (256 MB) or ATI Radeon HD 2600 Pro (256 MB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dire Wolf account required for online play
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 650M (1 GB) or ATI Radeon HD 5670 (512 MB) or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dire Wolf account required for online play

name: Clank! - Sunken Treasures

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit version only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 2000 graphics or Vega 8 graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dire Wolf account required for online play
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or better (64bit version only)
  • Processor: NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GT (512 MB) or ATI Radeon HD 4850 (512 MB) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 or OpenGL 3.x capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dire Wolf account required for online play
